items.problem: DPI-scaling migrations must reproduce (a) a logical-DPI readout, (b) a live update when display scale changes, and (c) a safe read of the current scale. The skill maps DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() -> XamlRoot.RasterizationScale but gives no LogicalDpi formula, no DpiChanged event mapping, and does not tie RasterizationScale reads to the 'read after Loaded' timing rule. The driver derived all three itself.
items.evidence: Migrated Scenario1.xaml.cs: 'double logicalDpi = 96.0 * XamlRoot.RasterizationScale;', 'XamlRoot.Changed += OnXamlRootChanged;', read from OnLoaded with 'if (XamlRoot != null)' guard in OnNavigatedTo. Sub-agent summary items 10-11. lessons.json failed_apis + dev_agent_struggles.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #getforcurrentview table row 'DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() -> XamlRoot.RasterizationScale or Win32 GetDpiForWindow' and the '### DisplayInformation is view-bound' subsection (lines ~325-340), which explicitly states 'The GetForCurrentView() row above only covers the DPI use case' then expands orientation members only. The XamlRoot-null-until-loaded rule exists but only in the ContentDialog context (line ~167).
items.proposed_improvement: In the existing '### DisplayInformation is view-bound' subsection, add a small DPI mapping table alongside the orientation one: DisplayInformation.LogicalDpi -> 96.0 * XamlRoot.RasterizationScale; DisplayInformation.RawPixelsPerViewPixel/ResolutionScale -> XamlRoot.RasterizationScale; DisplayInformation.DpiChanged -> XamlRoot.Changed. Add one timing line noting RasterizationScale/XamlRoot is null in the constructor and OnNavigatedTo, so read it from Loaded and refresh on XamlRoot.Changed (generalizing the XamlRoot-null rule already stated for ContentDialog).
items.generalizes: Every DPI-aware UWP sample (image scaling, custom rendering, print/measurement, per-monitor DPI) uses DisplayInformation.LogicalDpi/RawPixelsPerViewPixel and subscribes to DpiChanged, and reads scale during page init. Documenting the formula, the event, and the read-after-Loaded timing prevents a recurring class of silent blank-page/null-XamlRoot runtime traps across scenarios, not just this one.
